name: Solid Voxelization via Ray Casting
definition: A method to convert a triangle mesh into a solid voxel representation (octree) by casting rays through the mesh to determine occupied voxel intervals along the Z-axis.
summary: Solid Voxelization via Ray Casting converts triangle meshes into solid voxel octrees by explicitly computing occupied Z-intervals per pixel through ray-mesh intersection, distinguishing itself from methods relying on spatial pruning or topological checks.
